description: This file defines the ClientInterface interface within the GuzzleHttp namespace. It specifies the methods for sending synchronous and asynchronous HTTP requests, creating requests, and retrieving configuration options, along with a version constant.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request synchronously with specified options, returning a ResponseInterface.

methods.name: sendAsync
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request asynchronously, returning a PromiseInterface.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Creates and sends an HTTP request with specified method, URI, and options, returning a ResponseInterface.

methods.name: requestAsync
methods.description: Creates and sends an HTTP request asynchronously with specified method, URI, and options, returning a PromiseInterface.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration option or all configuration if no parameter is provided.
